source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Router' (PDF 9): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Router mukhtalif networks ko aapas mein jorta hai. Yeh data packets ko un ki sahi destination (manzil) ki taraf direct (rukh dena) karta hai. Routers local networks ko Internet se jorte hain. Yeh data bhejne ke liye IP addresses istemal karte hain. Routers network ki security (hifazat) aur control behtar karte hain. Ghar aur office ke networks mein routers bohat istemal hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Switch aur router mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Switch ek hi network ke andar devices jorta hai; router mukhtalif networks (maslan ghar ka network aur Internet) jorta hai aur IP addresses se packets ka raasta tay karta hai.

items: Router: mukhtalif networks jorta hai, IP addresses se packets ko manzil tak bhejta hai; ghar ko Internet se jorta hai.
